fields.text: Upload a product still; BiRefNet V2 (`birefnet/v2`) removes the background and keeps fine foreground edges. Size auto, $0.01/image. First-click story is a Volt pocket night-ride radio (matte charcoal body, one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron, dark slate / hard cyan rim) — this repo has no committed still, so upload that product photo or any catalog plate. This is a transparent cutout for compositing, not a relit seamless catalog (use Clean product photo) and not text-selected SAM 3. Inspect the native cutout for silhouette and edge detail; Export preview is a local 1024 fit only.

fields.prompt: Remove the background. Preserve the exact product silhouette, materials, markings and fine edges. Return a transparent cutout. Add no accessories, props, labels or branding.
